_: Which commit the MetaMax Reality graph is tied to. Written by the reality-ingest job; read by anyone who needs to know whether the graph can be trusted, WITHOUT a live backend.
_contract: graph_head is the commit the ingest READ, not the commit that wrote this file.
The ingest's own pin commit therefore sits one ahead of graph_head. A reader comparing
graph_head to HEAD must allow that one commit, or freshness never reads clean and any
Staleness = commits between graph_head and HEAD, excluding the pin commit itself.
Regen order is: push main -> TEST on main remote -> regen. Regenerating before the test
bakes an unvalidated state into the graph, and MetaMax can only test against main remote.
A declined regen stores nothing. The gap is derivable from this file and from the MCP's
freshness block, so the next session recomputes it rather than reading a flag that rots.
_known_issue: devtool_jobs.py records that a stale job row can SILENTLY block every subsequent reality-graph run for a project. If a regen appears to do nothing and this file does not move, check for an uncleared job before assuming the ingest is healthy.

_stale_as_of_writing.note: Not regenerated during the 2026-08-06/07 Stack Forge work. The graph predates the save-architecture rebuild, the carve.js wiring, the undo unification and every fix in epics AAA/AAD, so impact_of and does_exist are leads for that code, not facts.
